summary: Frontend-only test of Luchii batch: PDF paywall on /laws, Court constitution, /pay QR, /website-builder + /game-builder, /profile 'My Voice', landing marquee & footer. All target features PASS except /chat which crashes entirely due to missing state declaration (ReferenceError: hideHeader is not defined). Chat mobile edge-to-edge, header hide/show, attach menu contents and guest streamed reply could not be verified because the page never renders.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: hideHeader is not defined — the component uses `hideHeader` (lines 37, 72, 114, 116, 188) and `setHideHeader` (lines 72, 116) but never declares the state. The whole /chat route crashes to a blank page (React error boundary logs 'An error occurred in the <Chat> component'). Reproduces on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844), guest and logged-in.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Add `const [hideHeader, setHideHeader] = useState(false);` alongside the other useState hooks (near line 21).

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright click (even with force=true) does NOT fire the React onClick handler on `law-toggle-*` buttons — chevron does not rotate and the download button doesn't appear. Only synthetic `element.click()` via page.evaluate consistently expands the item. Real user clicks in a headed browser worked visually, so this is likely a hydration/event-timing quirk (button rendered before React attaches its synthetic listener), but it does hurt automated testability. Recommend adding an explicit onClick guard or using onPointerDown, or ensure hydration completes before interactive DOM is exposed.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add `const [hideHeader, setHideHeader] = useState(false);` (and any related init) in /app/frontend/src/pages/Chat.jsx near line 21. This one-line fix will unblock every /chat feature (mobile full-screen, header hide/show, attach menu, message send/stream retry/error-detail).

Optional: harden law-toggle-* buttons so Playwright's real click reliably fires the React handler (currently only element.click() via JS works). Consider adding useEffect-based lazy hydration or switching to onPointerDown.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat.jsx uses `hideHeader`/`setHideHeader` without a useState declaration — a runtime ReferenceError that took down the entire /chat page. This should have been caught by ESLint 'no-undef'; consider enabling / re-running lint in CI.

Laws.jsx: each row's expanded content is unmounted when collapsed; the download button is not present in the DOM until expansion. This is fine functionally but combined with the click-event issue makes automation flaky. Consider always rendering the download button (hidden via CSS) or exposing a data-testid on the wrapper to indicate expanded state.
Builder generation took ~55s for a tiny 1-page prompt; consider setting a client-side minimum SSE flush/heartbeat and a friendlier progress copy after 30s to reduce user anxiety on slow generations.

rca_of_the_issue: Chat.jsx crash: developer added a header hide/show feature (buttons at lines 71-78 and 114-123, and a conditional on line 37) but forgot to declare the useState pair. React throws ReferenceError on first render, error boundary catches it, page renders blank. Fix = one line: `const [hideHeader, setHideHeader] = useState(false);` after line 21.
